scope: Wonder:Root official preset listing demo inspected read-only via rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper actions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Wonder Root preset listing View demo opened the Wellness demo storefront.

claims.observed: Rendered PDP displays monthly recurring and one-time purchase modes, delivery-frequency discount choices and ingredient/benefit education; home and collection link to bundle building.
claims.risk: Visible controls do not prove pricing, cancellation, cadence-change or bundle behavior; health claims and reported outcomes are unverified.
claims.vsn_guard: Verify subscription price math, cadence, cancellation terms, bundle pricing and supporting health evidence before launch.

claims.observed: Demo repeats third-party testing, doctor recommendation, efficacy, customer-review, research-years and shipping statements.
claims.risk: Sample brand content is not evidence of testing, endorsements, clinical effects, reviews or shipping terms.
claims.vsn_guard: Require documented substantiation for health, scientific, endorsement, review and shipping claims.
